description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to elliptic curve point encoding and decoding, including conversion between byte representations and internal point structures, handling compressed and uncompressed formats, and related error handling.

methods.name: ec_point_byte_len
methods.description: Calculates the byte length needed to represent an EC point in a specified format (compressed or uncompressed).

methods.name: ec_point_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts an EC point to its byte representation in the specified format.

methods.name: ec_point_from_uncompressed
methods.description: Parses an uncompressed EC point from its byte representation.

methods.name: EC_POINT_oct2point
methods.description: Converts an octet string to an EC_POINT object, handling different point formats.

methods.name: EC_POINT_point2oct
methods.description: Serializes an EC_POINT to its octet string representation.

methods.name: EC_POINT_point2buf
methods.description: Allocates and returns a buffer containing the serialized form of an EC_POINT.

methods.name: EC_POINT_set_compressed_coordinates_GFp
methods.description: Sets EC point coordinates from a compressed form, recovering y from x and a sign bit.
